review_scope: Read-only review of frozen source, candidate, development artifacts and prospective cohort metadata. No confirmation media, features or results were read.

findings.finding: load_freeze does not verify training_source_snapshot_sha256 or subset_control_evidence_sha256 although both are stored in CANDIDATES.
findings.reproduction: In an isolated temporary copy, changing TRAINING_SOURCE.py and SUBSET_CONTROLS.json is accepted by load_freeze. The original artifacts both match their frozen hashes.
findings.resolution: Separate av_confirmation_guard.py verifies both fields before confirmation without changing the frozen model source.

findings.finding: confirm trusts supplied prepared feature/split archives beyond its independent-actor set check.
findings.resolution: Separate pre-confirmation guard verifies candidate/cohort, raw media sizes/hashes, extraction receipts and source identities, split metadata/hash, alias identity and reconstruction from verified clip features.

findings.finding: Base decoder scores exclude each held actor using GroupKFold. The calibrator then fits all training out-of-fold scores and labels and is applied back to those training rows.
findings.qualification: This is actor-out-of-fold base scores plus full-training calibration, not a nested out-of-fold entire encoder pipeline. It does not use fresh-actor data, and all compared cores receive the same probabilities.

findings.finding: The product consistency rule explicitly assumes conditional independence. Shared actor/emotion nuisance prevents treating it as an established true posterior.
findings.qualification: Separately trained full and subset relation heads remain valid ordinary controls.

findings.finding: confirm latency measures portable decoders and the construction rule after feature extraction.
findings.qualification: Whole-file decoding and fixed-prefix extraction costs are separate. This is not complete online media latency.

subsequent_historical_cohort_correction.blind_actor_scope: One actor absent from the explicitly audited 90-actor history union; point estimates only, no population confidence or adoption claim

guard_closure.covered: Actual frozen candidate/cohort/history identities plus synthetic raw/feature/split chains, corrected-hash label tampering, historical artifact tampering and rejection of an unseen-actor claim for the eight exposed actors
